build_ocsort_tracker: build a python module to instantiate OCSORT with a detector and tracker config for multi-object tracking
run_ocsort_predict: run OCSORT predict on a 5D video tensor to get tracking results per frame
run_ocsort_loss: run OCSORT loss calculation on a batch of inputs and tracking data samples
review_ocsort_init: review the OCSORT class init to configure detector and tracker via MODELS registry
refactor_ocsort_predict: refactor OCSORT predict to support batch sizes greater than one per GPU
